targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM availability WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND service IS NULL AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT version FROM device WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT uptime_seconds FROM device WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT printer_count FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'printing' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT device_count FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'printing' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time, cpu_percent AS "CPU", jvm_memory_used_percent AS "JVM Memory", disk_used_percent AS "Disk" FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'application' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time

SELECT status AS "Status", total_connections AS "Total", active_connections AS "Active", maximum_connections AS "Maximum", query_latency_ms AS "Query Latency ms", connection_latency_ms AS "Connection Latency ms" FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'database' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT printer_count AS "Printers", printer_errors AS "Printer Errors", held_jobs AS "Held Jobs", device_count AS "Devices", device_errors AS "Device Errors" FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'printing' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT service, status, total, offline, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM availability WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND service IS NOT NULL AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT service AS "Service", status AS "Status", total AS "Total", offline AS "Offline" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY service

SELECT valid AS "Valid", users_used AS "Users Used", users_licensed AS "Users Licensed", user_utilisation_percent AS "User Utilisation %", upgrade_assurance_remaining_days AS "Upgrade Assurance Days", installed_packs AS "Installed Packs" FROM license WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH latest_database AS (SELECT status, time FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'database' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), latest_printing AS (SELECT printer_errors, device_errors, held_jobs, time FROM performance WHERE collector = 'papercut' AND component = 'printing' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 'Database' AS "Component", status AS "State" FROM latest_database WHERE status <> 'OK' UNION ALL SELECT 'Printers', CAST(printer_errors AS VARCHAR) FROM latest_printing WHERE printer_errors > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Embedded Devices', CAST(device_errors AS VARCHAR) FROM latest_printing WHERE device_errors > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Held Jobs', CAST(held_jobs AS VARCHAR) FROM latest_printing WHERE held_jobs > 0
